rubrics.text: 1 p.m. to 4 p.m. with severe headache
intolerance of both cold and warm
driving him out of bed at night
increased by walking in open air
blood seems to burn in the veins
then internal burning heat with great thirst
which is cold to the touch
spreading from the hands over the whole body
alternating with heat not perceptible to the touch
oozing of dark thin blood from capillaries
so weak that he settles down in bed into a heap
says there is nothing the matter with him
as if dashed with cold water
distended veins and burning hands that seek out cool places
swollen veins of arms and hands without thirst
desire to be fan in place of thirst during the heat
sensation of coldness of the whole body
or hot water running through the blood vessels
heat of the whole body except the head
while the body feels cold to the touch
desires to be quiet in any stage
as if hot water were poured over one
with one cheek hot and red
on the other they are hot in evening and at night
cold feet and sweat on waking
chill followed by heat with sweat
with renewal of the earlier symptoms
intolerance of both cold and warm air
heat of the room is intolerable
great heaviness of limbs and trembling of the body
when sweat is checked from exposure to a draft of air
